status.noPlayer.title: Spotify isn't open
status.noPlayer.body: Sahne will connect on its own once you open Spotify and play a song.
status.idle.title: Nothing is playing
status.idle.body: {player} is open but nothing is playing right now.
status.estimated: The player doesn't report its position; time is being estimated.
lyrics.notFound: No lyrics found for this song
lyrics.offline: Offline — lyrics will be fetched once you're back online
settings.title: Settings
settings.offsetHint: Lyrics early? Press ] to delay them. Late? Press [ to bring them forward (100 ms steps).
styleHint.classic: Active line large and centered; words fill as they are sung.
styleHint.kinetic: Each word appears on its own in the middle of the screen.
styleHint.minimal: No motion, just the color fill.
styleHint.wave: Words rise one after another as they are sung, like a wave along the line.
styleHint.blend: Classic flow that switches to kinetic for fast passages, then back.
settings.keepAwake: Keep the screen on while the screensaver shows
settings.screensaverHint: Only while music plays; move the mouse or press a key and the windows go back to how they were. Keeping the screen on also delays the system lock screen.
styleHint.wall: Recent lines stack into a wall of big type that sways gently in 3D.
settings.edgeGlow: Edge light (colors flowing along the edges)

settings.announceHint: Reads each new line aloud with a screen reader, at most every two seconds.
